decision_rule: Use M111 matched-current-response pairs as an action-level intervention surface; proceed to rollout/outcome replay only if wrong/reset/delayed/zeroed histories cause measurable first-action changes while the actor input contract remains clean.
failure_criteria: matched pairs only differ in target probes but do not change policy action
reset or wrong history does not change action choice on the matched surface
the intervention uses hidden parameters or oracle labels as deployable actor input
the result is treated as driver admission without rollout/outcome evidence
hypothesis: M111 found current-response-matched future-envelope ambiguity, but current hidden states do not systematically encode it by feature distance. An action-level gate should test whether normal history, reset history, delayed history, zero-action history, and wrong matched history produce different first actions on that surface.
success_criteria: M111 matched pairs are reused or converted into replay snippets
normal/reset/delayed/zero-action/wrong-history variants are compared on first-action metrics
wrong-history actions are checked against the matched-right normal action
the result decides whether to proceed to rollout/outcome intervention gates
